name: drag-scroll
title: Drag scroll
description: A horizontal strip you can drag with a mouse, with optional snap and edge arrows, and full keyboard support. Touch keeps its native scroll.
docs: Mouse and pen drag the strip with a short glide when released; a drag never clicks the item under it. Touch keeps native scrolling. The strip is a focusable region named by label: arrow keys move by an item, Home and End jump to the ends. The wheel moves it sideways only while the pointer is over it, no modifier is held and there is room that way, so the page is never trapped. snap settles on the start or centre of an item. arrows adds previous and next buttons, shown only on devices with a fine pointer and only where there is more to scroll. className styles the wrapper; other props go to the strip.
